title: automate KMS/HSM + TLS certificate rotation for private-installer (helm / terraform)
author: Asha Mehta
description:
Motivation: Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) currently require manual steps to rotate TLS certificates and KMS/HSM keys across the private control plane, Helm charts, and Terraform-managed infra. This manual process is error-prone, risky during upgrades, and frequently surfaces in support tickets (SUP-895). This PR implements an end-to-end automation flow to rotate KMS wrapping keys, HSM-managed keys, and TLS certs for the private-installer deployment model and updates Helm and Terraform modules to support zero-downtime rolling rotation and safe rollback.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a rotation controller to the private-installer Helm chart to orchestrate rolling TLS cert replacement and trigger KMS/HSM key rewrap operations.
- Extends terraform/modules/kms and terraform/modules/hsm with rotation schedules, key versions, and an output-format that the installer can consume.
- Integrates Vault + sealed-secrets support: rotation controller can fetch new intermediate certs from Vault or accept sealed-secrets-updated manifests.
- Adds a migration/upgrade hook to the installer that coordinates node draining, KV cache warmup, and canary rollout of rotated assets.
- Provides docs, runbooks, and automated test harness (upgrade/rollback) in the tests directory.

Design notes:
- Rotation controller is implemented as a Kubernetes Job/Controller pair (helm templates) that validates new cert/key bundles, performs a staged rollout by namespace and pod label, and verifies connectivity to downstream services before proceeding.
- KMS/HSM support: terraform modules now expose a key_version and key_alias outputs; the controller triggers a rewrap API for cloud-KMS or a PKCS#11 rewrap helper for HSMs. All operations are idempotent and recorded in an audit annotation on the affected secrets.
- Vault + sealed-secrets: controller supports two modes: "vault" (pull new certs via Vault AppRole + KMS-unwrapped wrapping key) and "sealed-secrets" (operator provides updated sealed secret YAML and controller verifies signature + decryptability).
- Rollback: every rotation step writes a checkpoint (k8s annotation + S3/Terrastore entry). The installer provides a rollback command which reads the last-good checkpoint and restores previous secrets, then performs a controlled restart.

Files changed (high level):
- helm/redwood-private/templates/rotation-controller-deployment.yaml (new)
- helm/redwood-private/templates/rotation-job.yaml (new)
- helm/redwood-private/templates/secret-controller-configmap.yaml (updated)
- helm/redwood-private/values.yaml (new rotation config section)
- terraform/modules/kms/main.tf (added key_version, rotation_schedule outputs)
- terraform/modules/hsm/main.tf (added pkcs11 rewrap helper reference)
- private-installer/installer/upgrade.sh (installer hooks for rotation during upgrades)
- private-installer/installer/README.md (updated with rotation flags)
- docs/private/rotation-runbook.md (new)
- tests/upgrade/rotation-automation-test.yaml (integration test)

Commits (summary):
- 7f3b2a1: add rotation controller scaffolding and CRD-like config (helm templates + controller container image ref)
- b3e4c9d: extend terraform kms/hsm modules with rotation metadata and outputs; add unit tests for outputs
- c12a7ff: installer hooks + CLI flags to enable/disable rotation during upgrades; add runbook and docs
- d5f82e0: wire sealed-secrets and Vault modes into controller; add end-to-end tests
- e8a4b11: fix flaky test by adding retry/backoff to connection checks and add extra logging for auditability

Testing performed:
- Unit: terraform module unit tests for outputs + helm template rendering.
- Integration: ran rotation automation test against a cluster in CI that simulates Vault + cloud-KMS and a PKCS#11 HSM simulator. The test validates handoff, staged rollout, and successful application-level healthchecks.
- Upgrade/rollback: exercised upgrade path with rotation enabled and performed an automated rollback using the checkpoint mechanism.

CI status: primary pipeline passed after one flaky test rerun (connection-check retried). Checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-rotation (pass after rerun), lint (pass), e2e (pass).

Migration notes for operators:
- New values under helm/redwood-private/values.yaml: rotation.enabled (bool), rotation.mode (vault | sealed-secrets), rotation.kms_key_alias, rotation.hsm_slot_id, rotation.drain_timeout_seconds, rotation.parallelism. Default: disabled.
- For Vault mode: must provide Vault addr + AppRole credentials via the installer secrets. Provide KMS wrapping key in terraform output for the installer.
- For sealed-secrets mode: generate sealed secret manifests with the updated certs and apply them to the cluster; the controller will validate and adopt them.

Backwards compatibility and safety:
- Default behavior is unchanged unless rotation.enabled is set to true.
- Rotation controller validates the candidate assets and performs canary checks before changing Secrets.
- All steps are idempotent and annotations capture operation state to avoid double-apply on retries.

Review & discussion (high-level):
- Initial design reviewed with SRE + security to ensure auditability and HSM workflows (ENG-1298).
- Reviewers requested stronger audit annotations and a forced dry-run mode; both were added.
- A comment raised concern about Vault credential lifetime — we added a short-lived AppRole credential refresh path and documented it.

Known limitations / future work:
- HSM PKCS#11 integration currently depends on a vendor-provided user-space helper; we will upstream a small shim in a follow-up PR.
- We don't yet support multi-tenant rotation across multiple clusters from a single control plane instance (planned Q2).

Release notes: "Add optional automated TLS and KMS/HSM rotation for private-installer (Helm + Terraform). Disabled by default; see docs/private/rotation-runbook.md for operator instructions."

Merge outcome: squashed and merged to main after approvals and CI green.

Support references: SUP-895, linked linear ENG-1298, SRE-442.
